# All Goods Collection

> Owner-run streetwear shop in Prk. Orchids, Brgy. Paquibato, Davao City, Philippines. Sells Japan-surplus caps, tees, jackets, hoodies and bags. Any 3 items for ₱999. Orders through Facebook Messenger; payment by GCash.

Key facts:

- Name: All Goods Collection (also "All Goods Cllctn")
- Owner: Wenzly James, who picks the pieces and handles every order
- Location: small stall in Prk. Orchids, Brgy. Paquibato, Davao City. Walk-ins welcome; message before visiting to check stock.
- Products: fitted caps, snapbacks, graphic and logo tees, jackets, hoodies, sling and crossbody bags. Most pieces are one of a kind.
- Deal: any 3 items for ₱999 (promos can change; confirm when ordering)
- Payment: GCash, sent only after item and pickup details are agreed
- Delivery: pickup at the stall; meet-ups or shipping elsewhere in Davao City by request
- Hours: open daily
- Messenger: https://m.me/ZCllctnss
- Phone: +63 931 734 8736
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ZCllctnss
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/w1nsloy_/
